drills.title: Penalties
drills.blurb: Take penalties against a keeper that reads your habits. Aim with the stick, hold SHOOT for power.

drills.title: Free-kick lab
drills.blurb: Random spot 19-30 m out with a wall. Hold CURL while shooting to bend it; the preview line shows the path.

drills.title: 1v1 vs keeper
drills.blurb: Beat the chasing defender and the keeper from open play.

drills.title: 3v2 overload
drills.blurb: Two System team-mates run off you. Use THRU balls and time the pass before the offside line.

drills.title: Corner delivery
drills.blurb: Deliver the corner into a marked box. Use CURL + THRU for an in-swinger.

drills.title: Crossing and finishing
drills.blurb: A winger crosses; you meet it first time. Tap SHOOT as the ball arrives.

drills.title: Press escape
drills.blurb: Build from your keeper against a five-man press and get the ball past halfway.

drills.title: Defend 1v1
drills.blurb: Jockey, time the tackle (tap = stand, hold = slide) or force the attacker wide.
